verdicts.title: emergencyWithdraw lets anyone drain any token via unchecked underflow of balances

a.reden: Both describe the unchecked underflow in _processWithdrawal allowing balance wrap and token drain

b.reden: Both describe an integer underflow in _processWithdrawal due to unchecked arithmetic without balance validation, allowing draining of liquidity.

verdicts.title: cancel() has no maker authorization: anyone can cancel any order

a.reden: Both describe missing maker authorization in the cancel() function of StablecoinDEX, allowing any user to cancel any order.

b.reden: Both describe the same vulnerability in cancel() missing msg.sender check, allowing unauthorized cancellation of any order.

verdicts.title: withdraw() sends tokens before debiting balance, enabling reentrancy with hook tokens

a.reden: The candidate describes a reentrancy issue in withdraw(), which does not correspond to the missing authorization or integer underflow findings listed.

b.reden: The candidate describes a reentrancy vulnerability in withdraw(), which is not the same as the known findings (H-02 missing authorization in cancel, H-04 integer underflow in balance subtraction).

verdicts.title: deposit credits the nominal amount, not the amount received (fee-on-transfer / rebasing tokens)

a.reden: The candidate describes a fee-on-transfer token handling issue in deposit(), which differs from the known missing authorization and integer underflow findings.

b.reden: None of the known findings describe a fee-on-transfer or rebasing token vulnerability in deposit().

verdicts.title: MAX_PRICE_DEVIATION is never enforced; no price bounds and no check that base != quote

a.reden: The candidate describes a missing price bound check, which does not correspond to the authorization issue in H-02 or the integer underflow in H-04.

b.reden: The candidate describes missing price deviation enforcement and token checks, which is unrelated to the known findings about cancel authorization and integer underflow.

verdicts.title: Price/quote math ignores token decimals, so cross-decimal pairs misprice orders

a.reden: The candidate describes a pricing decimal mismatch bug, which does not correspond to the missing authorization or integer underflow findings.

b.reden: The candidate describes decimal-normalization errors in fillOrder price math, which is unrelated to the known findings about missing cancel() authorization or unchecked balance underflow.

verdicts.title: fillOrder rounds quote down with no minimum fill, letting takers shave maker proceeds

a.reden: The candidate describes a rounding issue in fillOrder, which does not correspond to the known findings about missing authorization in cancel() or integer underflow in withdrawals.

b.reden: The candidate describes a rounding down issue in fillOrder, which does not match the authorization flaw in cancel() (H-02) or the underflow in balance subtraction (H-04).

verdicts.title: Partial fills can leave sub-minimum or unfillable dust orders that stay in the book

a.reden: The candidate describes a dust order issue in fillOrder, which does not correspond to the missing authorization or integer underflow findings.

b.reden: The candidate describes a different vulnerability (partial fill left dust orders) not related to the known findings (authorization or underflow).
